buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant c ategory as per GeM GTC with the bid.

2. EMD & Performance security should be in favor of Beneficiary, wherever it is applicable. Beneficiar y: PAO MeitY/Office of CCA 3. In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Turnover / Experience Criteria, the supporting docum ents to prove his eligibility for exemption with specific category-based registration under MSME sc heme must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer. 4. Bidder should have a positive Net Worth of minimum 1 crore as per the last audited financial state ment. A certificate from chartered Accountant to be uploaded. 5. Bidder must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Support & escalation of non-service. 6. Bidder must provide Escalation Matrix with contact details of concerned person. 7. Buyer reserves the right to assess the performance of deployed manpower & request to replace an y outsourced manpower based on his/her performance. 8. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 9. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the p rior written consent of buyer. 10. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and sev erally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 11. Bidder should be ISO 9001:2015 certified company. 12. Bidder should follow the compliance of the statutory regulation and laws as per Govt. of NCT of Del hi / Government of India and other instructions issued from time to time. 13. Bidder should not charge any amount from the deployed manpower either as commission or as reg istration charges, etc in any form. 14. The EPF, EDLI and ESI will be paid as per the government rule. 15. The Service Charges of the agency will be extra, as per GeM / Govt guidelines. 16. The bidder has to submit Solvency Certificate of minimum value of Rs. 100 Lakhs from scheduled commercial Bank. The solvency certificate should not have been issued more than one month from last date of submission of bid. 17. The Engaged person has to work for 6 days a week with Sunday as the week holiday in general ho wever based on exigency of work, the engaged resource persons will be called for duty on holidays. Any duty on week holidays will be adjusted by a compensatory off in next 7 days only. 18. The agency has to supply the detailed bio-data before deployment of resource person for the reco mmendation from the Office of CCA through the process of short listing and/or personal interaction . 19. The resource person will be entitled for one earned leave for every completed period of one month service (minimum 30 days) which will lapse on completion of contract period between Office of CC A and the Selected agency, further any leave remaining on any account will not be adjusted again st any encashment, whatsoever the case may be. 20. The identified resource person will have no direct relation with the Office of CCA and must be on th e role of selected agency. The engaged person will not have any right of being engaged against an y vacancy either regular or contract in the Office of CCA and will not claim any type of appointmen t whatsoever from the Office of CCA. 21. The identified agency will indemnify Office of CCA for any illegal Regulatory/Statutory/Government obligations in respect of the deployed resource person. 22. The post-qualification experience of a minimum 3 years is essential for Engineering Graduates. Ho wever, in the case of Post-Graduates, i.e. Master Degree in Engineering in Computer Applications/ Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronics and Communication or other computer- related areas are exempted from the above post-qualification experience. 23. The specializations for Engineering Graduates/Post-Graduates are Engineering in Computer Applic ations/ Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronics and Communication or other comp uter-related areas.

24. Bidder need to retain the existing manpower as per buyer directions and Induction/replacement of any new manpower other than the existing need to be approved by buyer before its deployment. O/o CCA reserves the right shortlist or reject such offered manpower. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted by the bidder along with the bid. 25. The Service Provider shall pay the monthly salary of the deployed manpower on time, i.e. before t he 7th day of the following month, irrespective of the date of release of payment by the Buyer. In c ase of any delay in processing or release of bills/payment by the Buyer (including delay on the Ge M portal), the Service Provider shall continue to pay the salary of the deployed manpower from its own funds for a period of at least 3 (three) months, and shall not stop, delay or reduce the salary o f the deployed manpower on this ground. The Service Provider shall claim the said amount from th e Buyer as per the GeM payment process. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted by the bidder along with the bid. 26. Attendance in the pre-bid meeting is mandatory. Bids shall be accepted only from those bidders w ho attend the pre-bid meeting in physical mode on the date, time and venue specified in the bid d ocument. Bids of bidders who do not attend the pre-bid meeting shall be rejected. The pre-bid me eting will be held at the Buyer's office, i.e. Office of Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA), Elect ronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. .
